coverage: global grain, rice, maize and root staples; household, street and institution; temperate, tropical, arid and cold climates
reuse_rule: reuse plain pre-industrial staples; add only milled, fortified, instant or industrially processed forms
design_brief: Later milling, fortification, convenience and institutional staple forms with materially different nutrition, texture or economics.

coverage: breads, cakes, biscuits, pastry and chemically leavened baking; household, bakery, factory, school and relief
reuse_rule: reuse hearth and historic bakery stock; add new leavening, factory texture, fortified and convenience forms
design_brief: Distinct later baking processes and products, never cosmetic shape or flavour padding.

coverage: wheat, rice, starch and filled forms across household, street, restaurant and institutional contexts
reuse_rule: reuse matching pre-industrial dough and cooked forms; distinguish dried, instant, frozen or factory-filled mechanics
design_brief: Later dried, extruded, instant and cold-chain forms plus genuinely distinct composite servings.

coverage: vegetables, pulses, fungi and plant proteins; class, fasting, migration and institutional coverage
reuse_rule: reuse cooked vegetables and pulses; add preserved, textured, convenience and institutional preparations
design_brief: Plant dishes whose ingredient, processing, nutrition or serving form is genuinely later and distinct.

coverage: fresh-service transformations, dried, preserved and prepared fruit, nuts and seeds; climate and trade coverage
reuse_rule: reuse unchanged fresh and historic preserved forms; add mechanically distinct processed forms
design_brief: Industrial drying, pureeing, portioning and other transformations, excluding packages themselves.

coverage: dairy and egg foods across household, dairy, school, hospital, restaurant and transport service
reuse_rule: reuse historic cheeses, curds and egg dishes; add standardised, concentrated, dried and convenience forms
design_brief: Later dairy and egg processing with explicit perishability and nutrition distinctions.

coverage: processed meat, poultry, game and offal; household, factory, restaurant, military and migrant foodways
reuse_rule: reuse raw butchery outputs and historic cooked meats; add materially distinct comminuted, cured and convenience foods
design_brief: Processed edible products, never duplicate raw butchery outputs or package graphs.

coverage: fish, shellfish and other aquatic foods; coast, river, inland trade, institutional and transport contexts
reuse_rule: reuse fresh and historic preserved forms; add industrial preservation and convenience preparations
design_brief: Later processing and service forms with distinct ingredients, texture, preservation or economics.

coverage: global complete dishes across household, street, restaurant, workplace, school, hospital, prison, military and transport
reuse_rule: reuse recognisably unchanged dishes; separate defining fillings, sauces and nutrition profiles rather than skinning them
design_brief: High-value cross-cultural later dishes and convenience forms; separable accompaniments stay in serving manifests.

coverage: pickles, ferments, sauces, condiments, stocks and preserves; household, factory and food-service use
reuse_rule: reuse historic recipes when composition is unchanged; add standardised, emulsified, concentrated and novel preservation forms
design_brief: Processed accompaniments and preserves whose chemistry, composition or economic unit is distinct.

coverage: flours, meals, extracts, concentrates, cultures, powders and cooking stocks for household, institutional and mechanised chains
reuse_rule: adopt valid pre-industrial intermediates; new records require an identified consuming craft or edible use
design_brief: Consumed food-production intermediates, excluding raw crops, chemical reagents and packaging materials.

coverage: confectionery, sweet baking, puddings and frozen-dessert identities without unsupported temperature claims
reuse_rule: reuse historic sweets; add new textures, leavening, stabilisation, cold-chain identity and mass-production economics
design_brief: Distinct later desserts; flavour alone does not justify another base unless it changes ingredients, taste and economics materially.

coverage: street, workplace, school, leisure, convenience and transport snacks across class and climate
reuse_rule: reuse portable earlier foods; new rows require changed process, portion, nutrition or preservation rather than a wrapper
design_brief: Portable edible units and shared servings, always viable without retail packaging.

coverage: travel, military, naval, emergency, relief, expedition and institutional ration components
reuse_rule: reuse historic preserved foods as exact ration components; add processed components rather than monolithic imaginary meal packs
design_brief: Edible ration components; complete issues and menus are serving manifests or logistics graphs.

coverage: infant, fortified, convalescent, texture-modified and ordinary dietetic foods for household and care institutions
reuse_rule: reuse ordinary suitable foods without claiming suitability; drug-bearing therapeutic products remain medical
design_brief: Documented ordinary nutrition products with explicit ingredients and no unsupported medical claim.

coverage: livestock, poultry, working-animal and pet feeds across farm, stable, kennel, household and institution
reuse_rule: reuse raw fodder from agriculture; add cooked, compounded or nutritionally standardised feeds with a declared feed purpose
design_brief: Processed feed only; species-purpose metadata informs builders without claiming a universal feeding-rule subsystem.

coverage: water-based, dairy, fruit, grain, carbonated and oral-nutrition drinks across domestic, public and institutional service
reuse_rule: reuse unchanged stock liquids; add distinct processing, composition or freshness behavior, not a named container
design_brief: New liquid identities with exact hydration, nutrition and later freshness contracts.

coverage: coffee, tea, cacao and other documented stimulant infusions across producing regions, trade, workplace and hospitality
reuse_rule: reuse existing infusions when composition matches; new concentration or processing forms require health-profile linkage
design_brief: Caffeine-bearing drinks and intermediates with explicit dose evidence and no culture inferred from technology profile.

coverage: beer, wine, cider, spirits, mixed and reduced-alcohol forms across household, licensed service, ritual and institution
reuse_rule: reuse historic beverages; add distinct fermentation, distillation, blending, strength or serving-base identities
design_brief: Later beverage forms with exact alcohol content; cocktails with separable garnish remain liquid plus serving entries.

coverage: roasted, dried, concentrated, cultured, carbonated and dispensing inputs for domestic and commercial drink production
reuse_rule: adopt matching historic syrups, musts and brewing inputs; every new intermediate names a consuming route
design_brief: Consumed beverage-production inputs; containers, cylinders and dispensing equipment remain other domains.
